script_text: Pause, Pisces: a money decision could reveal what your relationship is really worth. On September 17, Neptune, your modern ruler, is sextile Pluto, connecting your solar 2nd House of Money with your 12th House of Secrets. The Sun illuminates your 7th House of Partnerships, while traditional ruler Jupiter occupies your 6th House of Work. For your water sign, these placements symbolically spotlight agreements, boundaries, and daily responsibilities. Single Pisces may notice attraction through familiar routines; partnered Pisces could find shared expenses becoming the conversation neither person can postpone. At work, Jupiter favors discussing expanded duties, but request written compensation terms before accepting extra tasks. Your 2nd House emphasis makes reviewing recurring charges especially relevant.
